infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Rescuetron needs your location to send live GPS coordinates to emergency services and family in case of an accident.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Rescuetron requires background location to detect vehicle crashes and monitor life safety while driving.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Rescuetron needs background location to alert emergency contacts even when your phone is locked or screen is off.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Rescuetron uses motion sensors to detect high G-force impacts and vehicle collisions.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Rescuetron to access your location in the background to detect vehicle crashes.
